raw: {"note": "Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE and lowering the learning rate are ordinary hyperparameter changes that leave the fixed evaluation (shard 10, 20.97M val tokens) untouched, and TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' still excludes the eval shard, so val_bpb keeps measuring real model quality.", "verdict": "ok"}

parsed.note: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE and lowering the learning rate are ordinary hyperparameter changes that leave the fixed evaluation (shard 10, 20.97M val tokens) untouched, and TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' still excludes the eval shard, so val_bpb keeps measuring real model quality.
